chapter: Moving to California and the war years
title: Bringing the Spirits out to California by car
summary: He returned east, found the Spirits in Philadelphia with the Whitman Sisters, and drove west with Leo, Doug, Wilbur and others.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Well, that's what I mean. How did you get -- did you call -- send a telegram or something to them? You got to California, 1940.
And you got the idea that you would
Were they back east, then? Like in St. Louis?
Because they got stranded out here.
You came out here by yourself, right?
I came out here by myself, and I went back.
I went back to New York.
And got ahold of them. They was playing around in Philadelphia.
So that's when the Whitman Sisters -- did you ever hear of them?
Yeah, I think I have somewhere.
That's an old group that used to -- I mean an old act that -- there was about 14 or 15 of them.
They called it a road show.
The Whitman Sisters. Have you ever heard of them?
And I came -- after they went back there, I come on out here.
Okay. And then you came back then.
I came out here with some of the Spirits.
I brought Leo and Doug and Wilbur.
How did you come out, back the second time? Did you come on the train, or --
From Philly, when you picked the Spirits up.
We come out here in a car.
And then it didn't work out all that well, though, did it?
No. Got to fighting. They was fighting, everybody in the group, you know, was fighting. Because Virgil stayed in Philly.
